summary: First iteration testing of IFPI LMS (FastAPI + React). Backend pytest suite created at /app/backend/tests/test_ifpi_api.py covers auth, courses, exams, learner flow, analytics, billing (stub), AI builder, certs verification — 27/27 tests PASS. Frontend Playwright covered: landing, public catalog, admin login → /dashboard with full nav, New Course → /courses/{id}/edit, Reports analytics, Users, Billing stub banner, Learner login → /courses with learner-only nav, Leaderboard, Certificates. All critical flows working end-to-end. AI builder endpoint responds successfully (~3-5s).

issues: Bar chart renders axis labels (2026-01..2026-06) but bars are not visibly drawn for non-zero months (e.g. 1 enrollment month). Consider min-height bar styling so single-enrollment months are visible.
Course cards have no cover image/banner area visible — uses a flat colored block which may look empty. Consider showing the cover_color or category emoji in the header.

Title field is not visible in the right sidebar settings panel (Description, Category, Duration, Passing score, Price, Status visible but Title field appears to live only in the header area as 'Untitled Course' static text; please confirm title is editable via the left sidebar).

action_items: Minor design polish: ensure Monthly Enrollments chart visibly renders bars for low-but-nonzero values (Reports page).
Confirm course title is editable on /courses/{id}/edit (could not find an input bound to title in the right-side Course Settings panel).

Console shows 401 errors on /api/auth/me when visiting public pages (landing, catalog) — this is the refresh interceptor probing for session. Consider suppressing these console errors for unauthenticated visitors to keep the console clean.
critical_code_review_comments: auth/cookies.py uses dual cookie mode — verify in production deploy AUTH_COOKIE_SECURE=true is set; current dev .env has secure=false which is fine for HTTP preview but must flip in prod.
routers/auth.py register endpoint does not call email-validation; any string accepted. Suggest pydantic EmailStr in RegisterRequest (likely already done — verify schemas).

routers/courses.py /enroll: when status != PUBLISHED query returns 404. Good. However admin self-enrolling on DRAFT course gets the same 404; consider allowing instructor/admin to preview-enrol unpublished courses.

routers/misc.py analytics: monthly bucket logic is correct and DB-agnostic. Top-courses uses outerjoin which counts NULL Enrollment as a row when no enrollments exist — verify count(Enrollment.id) returns 0 not 1 for courses with zero enrollments (it does via id NULL filter in COUNT).
services/billing_service.py stub mode auto-activates subscription — good. Webhook handler is in place and verifies signature; recommend log of signature failures for ops visibility.
EMERGENT_LLM_KEY is stored in plain .env — ok for dev; just confirm it is NOT committed to source control.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Tests create TEST_-prefixed courses and clean them up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_ifpi_api.py is the canonical regression test — run via `cd /app/backend && pytest tests/test_ifpi_api.py -v`. Two tests had initial schema mismatch (email lowercase normalization; exam answers is a dict {qid: ans}, not a list) and were fixed in this iteration. AI builder call is real and uses EMERGENT_LLM_KEY — completes in ~3-5s. Seeded course id=1 (IFPI Fundamentals, free, published, 5 slides) and seeded exam id=1 (4 questions, published) are the test fixtures.
rca of the issue: No bugs surfaced. Only minor design polish items above.
